sections.title: About
sections.content: Artist Florian Luthi reflects on a decade of work spanning sculpture, photography, and site-specific interventions. The talk traces the evolution of his material vocabulary and the questions of place and memory that anchor his recent exhibitions.

sections.title: Ticket Infos & Prices
sections.content: General admission: $15. Members and students: $10. Tickets can be reserved online in advance or purchased at the door subject to availability. Doors open thirty minutes before the talk begins.
